description: This file defines the Metadata class and related nested classes within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It provides data structures and interfaces for managing status information, service details, channels, server minions, subsystems, and inter-process communication (COMRPC). It also includes metadata interfaces for plugin services, including versioning, preconditions, termination, and control subsystems.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Main class holding status information, including services, channels, server info, subsystems, and inter-process communication data.

classes.name: Metadata::Service
classes.description: Represents a service with version, state, observers, and module information.

classes.name: Metadata::Channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel with remote endpoint, state, activity status, ID, and name.

classes.name: Metadata::Server
classes.description: Contains server minion data and pending requests.

classes.name: Metadata::Server::Minion
classes.description: Represents a minion process with ID, job, and run count.

classes.name: Metadata::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystems and their availability.

classes.name: Metadata::COMRPC
classes.description: Holds remote link information and associated proxies for inter-process communication.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for plugin metadata, including instance ID, precondition, termination, and control subsystems.

classes.name: Metadata<ACTUALSERVICE>
classes.description: Template class to convert objects into plugin services with versioning and subsystem control.

methods.name: State::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for State enum type.

methods.name: Service::operator=(const Plugin::Config&)
methods.description: Assigns configuration data to Service object.

methods.name: Server::Clear
methods.description: Clears server thread pool and pending requests.

methods.name: SubSystem::Add
methods.description: Adds a subsystem with its availability status.

methods.name: Metadata::InstanceId
methods.description: Converts a pointer or value to a Core::instance_id.

methods.name: Metadata::ThreadId
methods.description: Converts an instance ID to a thread ID, with specialization for pointer or non-pointer types.
